title: Mahavishnu Orchestra – Inner Mounting Flame With John McLaughlin- 8-Track Tape
descriptionText:
Format: 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
Artist: The Mahavishnu Orchestra with John McLaughlin
Album: The Inner Mounting Flame
Label: CBS / Columbia (Cat. No. 42-64717)
Year: 1972
Country: USA
Genre: Jazz Fusion, Progressive Rock
Track Listing (Programs):
A Lotus on Irish Streams • Awakening • The Dance of Maya (Pt. 1)
The Dance of Maya (Conclusion) • Meeting of the Spirits
Dawn • Vital Transformation
The Noonward Race • You Know You Know
Condition:
Cartridge: Original white CBS/Columbia shell. Heavy discoloration, scuffing, and label wear consistent with age.
Labels: Both front and back labels are intact but worn, with surface stains and edge peeling.
Tape: Visually intact, but untested — sold as a collectible display piece.
Slipcase: Not included.
Please review photos carefully — they are part of the description.
Notes:
Classic 1972 fusion album by the Mahavishnu Orchestra led by John McLaughlin.
Highly regarded as a landmark in jazz-rock and progressive fusion.
Vintage 8-track edition, collectible for both Mahavishnu fans and 8-track enthusiasts.
